claim: Roads are made for movement, not staying

text.text: Roads are made for movement, not staying
Frontage condition, and people staying or moving at each gate.
text.label: Figure

text.text: We counted people at six gates and graded every frontage. Of the pedestrians, 64% were commuting and 13% were out for a stroll. Of the 967 people who stopped, 326 stood at a shopfront and 269 were waiting.

The street moves people and gives them little reason to stay. More than twice as many sit on a wall, planter or parked vehicle as on a seat. All 95 joali sittings were in Area 01; the other five areas have none.
Staying: circle size shows how many
